title: PlainGym · Free and open source gym management
name: PlainGym
eyebrow: Free and open source gym management
pitch: Run your gym on your terms, with your data on your own server.
dataBody: Keep your gym's data in PostgreSQL on your own server. Take payments through your gym's own Stripe account and send encrypted backups to your own bucket.
standardsBody: Standard PostgreSQL, Docker and a documented OpenAPI API keep your setup in your hands.
openBody: AGPL-3.0 licensed, with every change public. Read the code, follow the work and make it your own.
selfHostBody: One install command on a small server gets you started. You choose where your gym runs.
demoHelp: Explore a shared sample gym as an owner, coach or student. No account to create.
